test_title: PYST 8: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 21 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose ‘No improvement’ as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

The subway __fare is go__ up next week.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the phrase 'is go up' is incorrect.
 
• The correct form should be **'is going up'** to indicate the** future continuous tense.**
 
• Therefore, the correct form of the verb 'is going' should be used in place of the incorrect form **'is go'.**

 Hence, the correct statement is **'*The subway fare is going up next __week*.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The **future continuous tense **is used for actions that will be ongoing in the future.
 
• It is formed using the structure: **subject + will be + present participle (verb+ing)**.
 
• **Example: *I will be traveling to New York next month*.**
